Unticking a skill drops it from the sear: Unticking a skill drops it from the search entirely, so the budget is not spent measuring a curve you would never act on — a mage has no use for ranged or melee. Wave transition: a measured 12-bin table: Wave transition: a measured 12-bin table (3,023–3,090 ms, mean 3,036.9 ms) over the server's 120 s clock cycle, not a flat 3 s. Checked against 2,395 dungeon transitions of our own: the same pattern, bin for bin. Two later readings, timed from the last monster reaching 0 HP over 144 and then 695 transitions, came out 25 and 28 ms above the table — the message latency the next sentence describes. A reading from your own client sits above it by however long the wave message took to reach you, which moves what you see and not what the game does, so the field is for the server's gap and is best left empty. Runs use a fixed clock anchor, so the same inputs give the same numbers.
